metadata.case_name: YIP KWOK MAN v. CHAN KIM KWAN

injuries.description: local redness in plaintiff's head (at a location above left ear)
source: On examination by Dr Poon at A&E Department of TKOH, local redness was noted in plaintiffs head (at a location above left ear).

source: On examination by Dr Poon at A&E Department of TKOH, ... A small laceration was found in the lower lip.

source: On examination by Dr Poon at A&E Department of TKOH, ... Upper lip bruising was noted.

source: On examination by Dr Poon at A&E Department of TKOH, Tenderness was noted in his left shoulder.

source: On examination by Dr Poon at A&E Department of TKOH, Another abrasion wound was noted in his left leg (at a positon slightly above knee level).

injuries.description: computer tomography of brain showed no signs of intracranial bleeding or skull fracture; bilateral lacunar infarcts noted (pre-existing, not related to assault)
source: On the same day, computer tomography of plaintiffs brain showed no signs of intracranial bleeding or skull fracture.

manifestations.description: fell down and lost his consciousness after the assault
mild pain at his left thumb
mild pain at his left shoulder
pain and weakness over his right wrist
pain over the dorsum of his right hand first web space
mild numbness over the right thumb and the finger pad of index finger
abrasion wounds on left hand (documented on examination)
left upper canine tooth loosened (documented on examination)

source: Wound dressing was performed on, and anti-tetanus toxoid was given to, the plaintiff.
Wound dressing was performed on, and anti-tetanus toxoid was given to, the plaintiff.
On the same day, computer tomography of plaintiffs brain showed no signs of intracranial bleeding or skull fracture.

treatments_received.treatment: X-ray of left shoulder, hands, and chest
source: X-ray of his left shoulder, hands, and chest showed no sign of fracture.

treatments_received.treatment: occupational therapy (one session) and soft thumb brace with reinforcer support
source: On 3 August 2012, the plaintiff attended one session of occupational therapy at TKOH.

A soft thumb brace with reinforcer support was prescribed to the plaintiff for his daytime use. Soft brace application and regime were also taught. Precautions in activities in daily living were taught. The plaintiff was advised to avoid strengthening of his right wrist.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from the multiple injuries sustained in the assault
